background.title: Our story
background.originDesc: Whizzzest began with university students in Beijing who wanted to share the culture of their hometown. The site helps visitors get to know Wanzai, a county in Jiangxi with a long fireworks tradition.
background.goalDesc: We want to use digital tools, including AI, to introduce Wanzai to more visitors and support the county’s tourism industry.

mission.title: Mission & vision
mission.missionDesc: We aim to build a comprehensive guide to Wanzai that helps preserve its fireworks traditions and makes it easier for visitors to plan a trip.
mission.visionDesc: We want Whizzzest to show how county-level tourism can use digital tools and social media. By working with local businesses and public institutions, we hope to build a model other counties can adapt.

tech.title: Under the hood
tech.edgeDesc: Cloudflare serves the site. The guides are built as static pages, while Workers render sections such as attractions, merchant listings, the library, music and video.
tech.zeroDesc: The main site uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript without a frontend framework. The build produces WebP variants for different screen sizes. Huanuo, the site’s question-and-answer assistant, runs on Workers AI and draws on information about Wanzai.

events.title: Project kickoff
events.description: The team formed, researched the project and agreed on what the guide should cover.

events.title: Product development
events.description: The team built a Vue and Tailwind CSS prototype with guides to heritage and local food.

events.title: Public launch
events.description: The guide opened to the public, and the team revised it after the first round of user feedback.

events.title: Brand building
events.description: The team began sharing updates and videos on WeChat, Douyin and other channels.

events.title: Rebrand & rebuild
events.description: The site moved to whizzzest.com and was rebuilt using native web technologies on Cloudflare.

events.title: Merchant listings
events.description: Whizzzest Picks added local listings, self-service merchant registration, email-code sign-in and verified listing options.

events.title: Whizzzest Streaming on air
events.description: Whizzzest Streaming launched with site-hosted and Bilibili videos, including the series “One Encounter, Ten Thousand Years” and the film “Meet Wanzai.”

events.title: Library & media
events.description: The library opened to local authors, with separate editorial review for books and chapters. The music player and attractions section launched around the same time.

events.title: AI & interactive experiences
events.description: Huanuo launched to answer questions about Wanzai, and the digital fireworks simulator opened in the browser.

events.title: Editorial and publishing tools
events.description: The team introduced shared access to the admin console, visitor analytics and automated site deployments.

events.title: Media rebrand · Whizzzest Arcade launch
events.description: The video and music channels took the names Whizzzest Streaming and Whizzzest Music. The browser game collection launched in the same period.

events.title: Legacy game collection retired
events.description: The previous Whizzzest Arcade collection was retired. The game subdomain is reserved for games we develop ourselves.
